context: The title at the top reads “Hash table.” A light blue rounded rectangle in the center shows five key-value pairs in two rows. The green boxes in the upper row hold student IDs (keys), and the teal boxes below hold names (values). A downward arrow in each column maps an ID to a name.
description: The table below lists the five pairs from left to right as shown. Their horizontal positions are for display only. The IDs need not be sorted, and the figure shows neither a bucket array nor a specific hash function.

frames.explanation: The gray box at the bottom reads “Enter a student ID (key) to look up the corresponding name (value)” and gives a lookup time of O(1). This is the ideal or average performance when hashes are well distributed and the load is appropriate. Severe collisions can still degrade lookup to O(n).
frames.title: Five mappings from student IDs to names

summary: Each student ID (key) maps to a name (value). Enter an ID to look up the corresponding name.

title: Key-value mappings and lookup in a hash table
